_note: What the little one says when the farmer talks to them (Talk, README.md, Villagers; Game._talk_child): the crawler babbles, the toddler has a few words of their own. The first pick whose if holds names the lines, one of them by the day; `stage` (a list of Child stages) picks by the age. %s is the child's name, put in by Child.named_dialogue before the box opens (each line is translated as a pattern, the name with it). The gift_ lines answer the toddler's gifts by reaction (gifts in data/child.json); the crawler takes none. No he / she: the name, they, the little one. Our own lines.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Ba-ba-ba! Bwah! (%s pats the tatami, very pleased with the noise.)

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Mmm... ah! (%s crawls over and grabs a fistful of your sleeve.)

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Eeh-heh-heh! (%s laughs at nothing at all, and then at you.)

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Buh? (%s holds up a fist and opens it. Nothing inside. Wonderful.)

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Aaah... (%s yawns a huge yawn and rubs one eye with a fist.)

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Ah! Ah! (%s crawls straight to you as fast as small knees go, arms up.)

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Hee-hee! (%s tries to say your name. It comes out as a bubble.)

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Mm. (%s is busy chewing on a corner of the cushion.)

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Bah. (%s has found a patch of sun on the mat and is watching it.)

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Look! Look! I walk! ...Oops. I sit.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Bird! Big bird! It go flap-flap-flap!

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Mine. ...Okay, yours. ...No. Mine.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Up! Up, up! ...Again! Again!

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Morning! Is it morning? It's morning!

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: You home! I waited. I waited a looong time.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: I love you this much! (%s throws both arms out wide and sits down hard.)

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Rain go plip-plop. I stay in. I make a fort.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Snow! I eat it. ...Cold! Cold, cold!

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Goro! Goro, sit! ...Goro no sit.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Dirt! Good dirt! (%s holds out a handful, very proud of it.)

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: I help farm! I dig hole. Here. And here. And there.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Goro lick my face! ...Again, Goro!

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Busy. I'm busy. Rock pile.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: (%s waves at you, then goes back to chasing a moth.)

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: For me?! Sweet! Mmm! Thank you, thank you!

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Ooh. For me? Thank you!

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Hm? ...Okay. (%s puts it on a pile of treasures.)

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Bleh. No. (%s hands it back with a frown.)

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Yuck! Yucky! (%s scrunches up their face and pushes it away.)

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: More? No. You gave me already. Silly.
